object.description: Setup: a saved workout of 5.00 km, duration 25:00 (pause of 2 min excluded), whose fastest full split is 4:30 per km and whose final partial split is faster than 4:30 per km. Steps: 1. Open the workout. 2. Read the figures. 3. Set the distance unit to mile and read again. Expected: Distance 5.00 km, duration 25:00 and average pace 5:00 per km; peak pace 4:30 per km (partial split ignored); all distance and pace figures in miles in step 3.
